cards.caption_en: A bite of cake, a little fruit jelly, and the smell of baking.
cards.caption_zh: 一口蛋糕，少许果冻状果酱，还有烘焙的香气。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated ivory clothes, loose low bun, natural skin pores and subtle magazine retouch, realistic hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, pearl white and slate palette with appetizing natural food colors. Environmental portrait with teaching props clearly readable, reserved calm space near top and lower corners for later annotation. No text, numbers, labels, branding, watermark or UI. Elegant small bakery kitchen. Open built-in oven clearly visible at rear left. Woman seated at counter with a small fork holding one bite of cake near her mouth, no need to show teeth. Foreground: one round golden sponge cake on white stand, topped with a thin glossy translucent smooth seedless red FRUIT JELLY preserve; one slice removed. Separate small white cup of dark coffee beside cake. Cake, oven and jelly clearly visible, calm upscale composition.

words.example: The cake comes out of the oven.
words.evidence: 后方打开的烤箱

words.example: The cake is on a stand.
words.evidence: 前景圆形海绵蛋糕

words.example: I spread fruit jelly on the cake.
words.translation: 我在蛋糕上涂果冻状果酱。
words.evidence: 蛋糕上平滑无籽的红色果酱层；采用美式果冻状果酱义，身份由设定说明

words.example: The cake has a sweet taste.
words.evidence: 味觉由例句说明，不能从照片测量

words.example: I love the smell of fresh cake.
words.translation: 我喜欢新鲜蛋糕的香气。
words.evidence: 嗅觉由原创场景叙述说明

words.example: The coffee tastes bitter.
words.evidence: 咖啡味道由例句说明，不把蛋糕说成苦的

words.example: This is a good cake.
words.evidence: 评价由叙述者表达

words.example: Burned cake has a bad taste.
words.evidence: 条件性例句；不声称图中蛋糕烤焦

words.example: I take a bite of cake.
words.evidence: 叉上靠近嘴边的一小口蛋糕，bite采用名词一口；区域定位小块，不声称照片证明已经咬下。

cards.caption_en: A little salt, a small amount of oil, and enough time to cook.
cards.caption_zh: 少许盐，少量油，再留足烹饪的时间。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated ivory clothes, loose low bun, natural skin pores and subtle magazine retouch, realistic hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, pearl white and slate palette with appetizing natural food colors. Environmental portrait with teaching props clearly readable, reserved calm space near top and lower corners for later annotation. No text, numbers, labels, branding, watermark or UI. Refined home kitchen, elevated three-quarter view. Woman gently stirring marinade in small ceramic bowl with spoon. In clear foreground separate raw beef steak on wooden board at left with conspicuous real white FAT marbling and a small white fat edge; tiny open ceramic dish of white SALT crystals center-front; small clear glass carafe of golden cooking OIL right-front. Meat, fat, salt and oil distinct and unobstructed. Hands do not touch raw meat. A few herbs only, uncluttered cool kitchen.

words.example: The meat is on the board.
words.evidence: 前景牛肉块；不含砧板

words.example: The meat has a little white fat.
words.translation: 这块肉带有少许白色脂肪。
words.evidence: 牛肉中可见的白色脂肪边缘

words.example: The oil is in a glass carafe.
words.evidence: 玻璃小壶里的金黄色食用油

words.example: The salt is in a small dish.
words.evidence: 小碟中的白色颗粒，盐的身份由设定说明

words.example: The ingredients are mixed together.
words.evidence: 手中碗里的混合食材区域，mixed描述已在碗中组合的食材；不框整个厨房。

words.example: I use a small amount of oil.
words.evidence: 数量由例句表达，不从照片推算容量

words.example: The addition of salt gives the meat more flavor.
words.evidence: 名词添加这一过程，由例句说明

words.example: We have enough salt for the meat.
words.translation: 我们有足够的盐给肉调味。
words.evidence: 限定词修饰salt，足量依菜谱语境判断

words.example: The sauce becomes sticky as it cooks.
words.evidence: 过程性例句，不从静态图推断触感

cards.caption_en: A glass of wine, a quiet table, and an unhurried evening.
cards.caption_zh: 一杯葡萄酒，一张安静的餐桌，一个不赶时间的夜晚。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated ivory clothes, loose low bun, natural skin pores and subtle magazine retouch, realistic hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, pearl white and slate palette with appetizing natural food colors. Environmental portrait with teaching props clearly readable, reserved calm space near top and lower corners for later annotation. No text, numbers, labels, branding, watermark or UI. Cool sophisticated apartment dining portrait. Adult woman at rear left seated calmly, no drinking action. Foreground still life on pale linen: one upright dark green transparent WINE BOTTLE at left with only a little red wine remaining at bottom, no label; one natural beige CORK lying horizontally in front of bottle; ONE clear stemmed wine GLASS at right filled with red wine almost to rim, visible meniscus with small safe gap. Bottle and glass distinct and large, liquid levels coherent, elegant window light, no extra glassware.

words.example: The bottle is on the table.
words.evidence: 左侧葡萄酒瓶整体

words.example: The cork lies beside the bottle.
words.evidence: 瓶子前方独立软木塞

words.example: The glass holds red wine.
words.evidence: 杯中红色葡萄酒，身份由设定明确

words.example: The glass has a long stem.
words.translation: 这只玻璃杯有细长的杯柄。
words.evidence: 右侧高脚玻璃杯整体

words.example: Wine is a liquid.
words.evidence: wine是liquid的可见实例，区域定位玻璃杯中实际液体。

words.example: The glass is nearly full.
words.evidence: 盛至近杯口的玻璃杯区域，full指杯子的可见装满状态；例句nearly full保留程度限定。

words.example: There is only a little wine in the bottle.
words.evidence: 瓶底少量葡萄酒的液面和内容区域，little定位瓶内少量的wine，不框整瓶或全图。

words.example: There is too much wine in this glass.
words.translation: 这只杯子里葡萄酒太多了。
words.evidence: 杯中较多葡萄酒的区域，much修饰wine；too much的评价仍来自原创句子，不推算容量。

words.example: A glass of wine is on the table.
words.evidence: 介词of连接容器量词与内容物，不设物体框

cards.caption_zh: “请给我汤。”“要茶吗？”“好的，请来一杯，但不要糖。”
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated ivory clothes, loose low bun, natural skin pores and subtle magazine retouch, realistic hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, pearl white and slate palette with appetizing natural food colors. Environmental portrait with teaching props clearly readable, reserved calm space near top and lower corners for later annotation. No text, numbers, labels, branding, watermark or UI. Fictional 1890 manor-house tea room, original historical scene, no real venue. Two adult East Asian women: young female guest at left in understated pearl-grey period dress seated at table; HOUSEHOLD SERVANT at right in modest historical slate dress and simple white apron, offering small tray with one white teacup, dignified everyday interaction. Table foreground includes bread plate at left and soup bowl center-right. Cool soft window light, pale elegant wooden interior, period costumes subtly tailored and realistic; NOT a modern café waitress. Faces and hands readable, calm negative space at top and bottom for 11 annotations.

words.example: Soup, please.
words.evidence: 点单对话中礼貌表达

words.example: My request is for a bowl of soup.
words.evidence: 名词请求，原创对话明确内容

words.example: I offer the guest a cup of tea.
words.translation: 我主动给客人提供一杯茶。
words.evidence: 服务角色把茶杯托盘举向客人的提供动作区域；offer由服务者口吻的原创句子明确。

words.example: I need a spoon for the soup.
words.evidence: 需要由话语说明

words.example: I have a desire for a quiet cup of tea.
words.evidence: 采用名词愿望，不由表情推断

words.example: The selection includes bread and soup.
words.translation: 可选食物包括面包和汤。
words.evidence: 桌面可选择的面包、汤与茶食区域；selection的具体选项由原创设定说明，不把抽象选择意愿框成人物。

words.example: Would you like bread or soup?
words.evidence: 并列连词说明两种选择

words.example: I would like some bread.
words.evidence: 限定词修饰不可数bread

words.example: No, thank you. I do not want sugar.
words.translation: 不用了，谢谢。我不想加糖。
words.evidence: 明确否定答复，不能由表情判断

words.example: Yes, please. I would like tea.
words.evidence: 明确肯定答复，不能由表情判断

words.example: In this fictional old manor, a servant brings tea.
words.translation: 在这座虚构的旧式庄园里，一位仆人端来茶。
words.evidence: 右侧站立持托盘女性为虚构1890庄园的servant角色；区域仅定位故事角色，不把现代服务员认定为仆人。

cards.caption_en: I cover the last bit of food because tomorrow is another day.
cards.caption_zh: 我把最后一点食物盖好，因为明天又是新的一天。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated ivory clothes, loose low bun, natural skin pores and subtle magazine retouch, realistic hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, pearl white and slate palette with appetizing natural food colors. Environmental portrait with teaching props clearly readable, reserved calm space near top and lower corners for later annotation. No text, numbers, labels, branding, watermark or UI. Woman at center gently placing a round ceramic LID onto a matching round FOOD STORAGE VESSEL on table front-center; lid held clearly separate tilted above container, only one lid, coherent hands. words.example: I do not waste food.
words.evidence: 保存剩食的故事与否定例句

words.example: The cover fits the vessel.
words.evidence: 手中圆形容器盖，采用名词义

words.example: The vessel holds the soup.
words.evidence: 前景盛汤的瓷制容器；此处正式用语容器义，不是船

words.example: A drop of soup is on the saucer.
words.evidence: 勺子托碟上的独立小汤滴

words.example: I save a bit of food for tomorrow.
words.evidence: 左侧小盘里的一小块面包；bit定位少量食物，last的最后一块身份由原创场景设定说明，不由外观判断时间顺序。

words.example: This is the last piece of bread.
words.evidence: 左侧小盘里的一小块面包；bit定位少量食物，last的最后一块身份由原创场景设定说明，不由外观判断时间顺序。

words.example: I clear the table at the end of the meal.
words.translation: 用餐结束时我收拾餐桌。
words.evidence: 名词结束，由餐后叙述说明

words.example: I cover the food because we need it tomorrow.
words.translation: 我把食物盖好，因为我们明天还需要它。
words.evidence: 引导原因从句的连词，无独立可见物体

lexical_review.method: Codex按本卡语境独立编辑复核；不将源表未经复核内容直接作为成品，不声称已访问词典全文。
